# Agent Memory: AI Memory Systems Explained

> Sourced technical guides on AI agent and LLM memory: memory types, context windows, retrieval, and the tools that implement them.

Each article answers one question about memory for AI agents and LLMs. Start with the guides, then follow the topic you need.

## Guides
- [Context Window of an LLM: Tokens, Limits and Memory](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/context-window-of-an-llm/): What the context window of an LLM is, how input, output and thinking tokens share it, why it has a limit, and how it differs from real memory for AI agents.
- [AI Agent Memory Explained: Types, Storage and Tools](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-agent-memory-explained/): What AI agent memory is, the four memory types (working, episodic, semantic, procedural), how agents store and retrieve memories, and the main tools in 2026.

## Articles
- [Agent Memory Leaderboard: Benchmarks and Scores](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/agent-memory-leaderboard/): Agent memory leaderboard guide: where to find LongMemEval, LoCoMo and BEAM results, who runs each leaderboard, a score table with sources, and why scores differ.
- [Agent Workflow Memory (AWM): How It Works and Results](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/agent-workflow-memory/): Agent Workflow Memory (AWM, ICML 2025) explained: how agents induce reusable workflows from past runs, online vs offline modes, WebArena and Mind2Web results, limits.
- [AgentCore Memory: AWS Long-Term Memory Deep Dive](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/building-smarter-ai-agents-agentcore-long-term-memory-deep-dive/): How Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory works: events, short-term vs long-term memory, the four built-in strategies, namespaces, Python code and October 2026 pricing.
- [agentmemory: Persistent Memory for AI Coding Agents](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/agentmemory/): agentmemory (rohitg00) explained: persistent memory for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, npx setup, its self-reported benchmarks, vs Hindsight and Mem0.
- [AI Agent Architecture Patterns: ReAct to Multi-Agent](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-agent-architecture-patterns/): The main AI agent architecture patterns compared: ReAct, plan-and-execute, ReWOO, LLMCompiler, Reflexion, workflows, multi-agent, and where memory fits in each.
- [AI Agent Framework Comparison: How Each Handles Memory](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-agent-framework-comparison/): LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Google ADK, Letta, LlamaIndex and Pydantic AI compared on memory: sessions, long-term stores, plug-ins.
- [AI Agent Long-Term Memory: How It Works, How to Build It](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-agent-long-term-memory/): How long-term memory works in AI agents: does AI have it, the index-retrieve-read pipeline, what LongMemEval found, its limits, and a LangMem example.
- [AI Agent Planning Memory: Keeping and Reusing Plans](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-agent-planning-memory/): How AI agents remember plans: to-do lists in working memory, plans stored as episodes, and plan reuse through workflow memory and plan caching, with code.
- [AI Coding Agent Memory: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and More](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-coding-agent-memory/): How AI coding agents remember projects: Claude Code CLAUDE.md and auto memory, Codex AGENTS.md and memories, Cursor rules, Copilot Memory, and external memory tools.
- [AI Dungeon Memory System: Memory Bank and Story Summary](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-dungeon-memory-system/): How AI Dungeon's Memory System works: memories every six actions, Auto Summarization, the Memory Bank's embedding search, slots per tier, and how context is built.
- [AI Memory Architecture: Components and Design Patterns](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-memory-architecture/): How an AI memory architecture is built: extraction, stores, indexes, retrieval, context assembly and consolidation, plus the six main families of memory design.
- [AI Memory Decay: How and Why Agents Forget](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-memory-decay/): AI memory decay explained: recency scoring, Ebbinghaus forgetting curves, expiry and validity windows, plus the unplanned forgetting caused by long contexts.
- [AI Memory Injection: How Agent Memory Gets Poisoned](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-memory-injection/): AI memory injection plants malicious content in an agent's long-term memory so it misleads later sessions. Real attacks (MINJA, AgentPoison, SpAIware) and defenses.
- [AI Memory MCP Servers: Official Server and Alternatives](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-memory-mcp-server/): What an AI memory MCP server is, how the official MCP memory server's knowledge graph works, and how Graphiti, Basic Memory, Mem0, MemPalace and Hindsight compare.
- [Azure AI Foundry Memory: Agent Service Long-Term Memory](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/azure-ai-foundry-long-term-memory/): How long-term memory works in Azure AI Foundry Agent Service (Microsoft Foundry): memory stores, memory types, scope, TTL, quotas, regions, pricing and Python code.
- [Best AI Memory Framework: How to Choose by Use Case](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/best-ai-memory-framework/): Which AI memory framework should you pick? A decision guide by use case: Mem0, Zep, Letta, Cognee, LangMem, Supermemory, Hindsight and Honcho, with prices.
- [Best Chatbot for Memory: Which AI Apps Remember You](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/best-chatbot-for-memory/): Which chatbot has the best memory in 2026? A sourced comparison of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Character.AI: what each remembers, free plans, controls.
- [Best In-Memory Vector Databases: FAISS, Chroma, More](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/best-in-memory-vector-database/): The best in-memory vector databases by language: FAISS, hnswlib, USearch, Chroma, Qdrant local mode, LangChain and Spring AI stores, with Python code.
- [Build a Chatbot with Memory in LangGraph (Python)](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/chatbot-with-memory-langgraph/): How to build a chatbot with memory in LangGraph: a checkpointer for chat history, a store for long-term user memory, Postgres for production, and example repos.
- [Character.AI Memory Limit: Pins, Chat Memories, Lorebooks](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/what-is-character-ai-memory-limit/): What is Character.AI's memory limit? Why characters forget, the real limits on pins (15 or 30) and Chat Memories (400 characters), and how to improve memory.
- [Chatbot Memory on GitHub: Open-Source Repos (2026)](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/chatbot-memory-github/): A checked list of GitHub repos for chatbot memory: chat apps with built-in memory, memory libraries and templates, with license, stars and how each one remembers.
- [Claude AI Long-Term Memory: How It Works and Settings](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/claude-ai-long-term-memory/): Does Claude have long-term memory? How Claude's memory and chat search work, plans, how to turn memory on, import from ChatGPT, context window sizes, and the API.
- [Claude Code Memory: CLAUDE.md, Auto Memory and Plugins](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/claude-code-memory/): How Claude Code memory works: CLAUDE.md locations and load order, @imports, auto memory and how to turn it off, /memory, plus memory MCP servers, claude-mem and Hindsight.
- [Codex Memory: AGENTS.md, Memories and Add-ons](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/codex-memory/): How OpenAI Codex memory works: AGENTS.md load order and 32 KiB limit, Codex memories in ~/.codex/memories, config keys, /memories, and adding Hindsight or agentmemory.
- [Cognee Alternatives: 6 Agent Memory Tools Compared](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/cognee-alternatives/): Cognee alternatives compared: Mem0, Graphiti, Zep, Letta, Hindsight and Supermemory. What each does, licenses, self-hosting and pricing, checked October 2026.
- [Context Window Limitations in LLMs and How to Fix Them](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/context-window-limitations-solutions/): Why LLMs get worse as the context window fills: lost-in-the-middle, effective vs advertised context, cost and latency, plus fixes like retrieval and memory.
- [CrewAI Long-Term Memory: The Unified Memory Class](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/crewai-long-term-memory/): How CrewAI long-term memory works since v1.10: one Memory class with scopes, LanceDB storage, composite recall scoring, embedder setup, and how to reset it.
- [Dify LLM Memory: Node Memory, Window Size, Variables](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/dify-llm-memory/): How memory works in Dify: LLM node memory and window size in Chatflow, conversation variables, Agent App history compaction, and plugins for long-term memory.
- [Embedding Models for RAG and Agent Memory (2026)](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/embedding-models-for-rag/): How to choose an embedding model for RAG and agent memory: MTEB scores, dimensions, context length and cost for OpenAI, Gemini, Voyage, Cohere, Qwen3, BGE-M3.
- [Episodic Memory in AI Agents: How Agents Recall Events](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/episodic-memory-in-ai-agents/): What episodic memory is in AI agents and LLMs, what an episode record holds, how Generative Agents and Reflexion use it, and how to build one with FAISS.
- [Extending the LLM Context Window: How It Works](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/extending-llm-context-window/): How to extend an LLM context window: position interpolation, NTK and YaRN RoPE scaling, LongRoPE, long-context fine-tuning, ring attention and KV cache tricks.
- [Gemini AI Long-Term Memory: Past Chats and Settings](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/gemini-ai-long-term-memory/): How Gemini's long-term memory works in 2026: memory from past chats, asking Gemini to remember, requirements, how to delete it, temporary chats and context windows.
- [Google Titans: How AI Learns to Memorize at Test Time](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/google-titans-give-ai-human-like-memory/): Google Titans explained from the paper: a neural long-term memory that learns at test time using surprise, momentum and forgetting, its MAC/MAG/MAL variants and results.
- [Hermes Agent Memory: MEMORY.md, USER.md and Providers](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/hermes-agent-memory/): How Hermes Agent memory works: MEMORY.md and USER.md limits, the frozen snapshot, session search, external providers like Honcho and Mem0, and fixes when it fails.
- [Hierarchical Memory for LLM Agents: Tiers and Trees](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/llm-hierarchical-memory/): How hierarchical memory works in LLM agents: MemGPT-style tiers, MemoryOS, and abstraction trees like RAPTOR, H-MEM and Zep's graph layers, with code.
- [Hindsight AI Memory: How It Works and When to Use It](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/ai-memory-hindsight/): Hindsight is an MIT-licensed agent memory server with retain, recall and reflect. How it works, its BEAM benchmark lead, its limits, and when to pick another tool.
- [Holographic Memory for AI Agents: HRR Explained](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/holographic-memory-ai-agent/): What holographic memory means for AI agents: holographic reduced representations (HRR), how bind and unbind work, and the Hermes Agent holographic provider.
- [Honcho LLM Memory: Peers, Reasoning and Setup](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/honcho-llm-memory/): What Honcho is: Plastic Labs' open-source memory for LLM agents. How peers, sessions and background reasoning work, Python SDK, self-hosting, pricing, evals.
- [How AI Memory Works: Write, Store, Retrieve, Inject](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/how-ai-memory-works/): How AI memory works in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and custom agents: the model forgets, so the app saves notes, searches them and adds them to the prompt.
- [How LLM Memory Works: Weights, Context and KV Cache](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/how-llm-memory-works/): How LLM memory works inside the model: knowledge in weights, the context window, the KV cache, why each API call is stateless, and where external memory fits.

- [Zep Alternatives: Open-Source and Hosted Options](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/zep-alternatives/): Zep alternatives compared, including open-source options after Zep Community Edition: Graphiti, Mem0, Letta, Cognee, Hindsight and Supermemory (Oct 2026).
- [Zep Docker in 2026: Self-Hosting Options Explained](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/zep-memory-docker/): Can you run Zep memory with Docker? Zep Community Edition is deprecated. The self-hosting options now: Graphiti server and MCP containers, legacy CE, BYOC.
- [Zep vs Mem0: Temporal Graph vs Fact Memory](https://aiagentmemory.org/articles/zep-memory-vs-mem0/): Zep vs Mem0 compared (Oct 2026): temporal context graph vs extracted facts, open source, self-hosting, APIs, pricing, the benchmark dispute, how to pick.
